entities.name: Fear Island
entities.description: Island in the Sea of Serenity in southwestern Jamuraa on Dominaria whose fortifications Declan planned.

entities.name: Declan
entities.description: Young man who planned Fear Island's fortifications and later became city architect of Palmyra.

entities.name: King Gaynor
entities.description: King whose navy attacked Fear Island.

entities.name: Palmyra
entities.description: City where Declan later became architect.

events.summary: King Gaynor attacks Fear Island but Declan's defense splits his navy on the rocks.
events.quote: Declan's excellent defense split the king's navy on the rocks of the island

relations.note: Gaynor attacked the island Declan defended.
relations.quote: The island was attacked by King Gaynor
